VBO:0200079.summary: Arubian Cunucus tend to be friendly, affectionate and energetic, with plenty of interest in running and play. Fetch, agility and lure coursing give that energy different outlets, while their quick leaps help them pursue lizards among Aruba’s rocks.
VBO:0200079.shortDescription: An affectionate, energetic Aruban local dog that often enjoys running, fetch and agile jumping.

sources.title: Animal Relief Foundation Aruba — local rescue organization Cunucu guide
sources.evidence: Complete actual first-party Aruban rescue guide describes friendly, affectionate, energetic tendencies and interest in running, agility, lure coursing and fetch. It connects long-legged maneuverability/jumping to pursuing lizards among rocks. Copy hedges tendencies and uses only those character/activity/function claims. No ancestry legend, intelligence ranking, fixed exercise dose, child/apartment suitability, health or guarantee claims.
